requirement: The system shall refuse to accept a second ballot from a voter who has already cast one in the current election.
The system shall tabulate the election result by summing the first-preference votes for each candidate and identifying the candidate with the highest total.
The voter selects a candidate and confirms; the system records the ballot, marks the voter as having voted and shows a confirmation receipt.
The voter verifies their identity through a code sent to their registered channel; the system admits them to the ballot only once that code has been confirmed.
As an election officer, I want to open and close polling for an election so that voters can only cast ballots during the designated window.
As a voter, I want to view the list of candidates standing in my election, together with their statements, so that I can decide how to vote.
A voter's ballot must remain anonymous; the system shall never store the voter's identity together with the contents of their ballot.
A vote must only count if the voter was eligible on the polling day and the ballot was cast within the official window; invalid ballots must be rejected in the tally.
The ballot table shall ensure that every ballot references a valid election and that the cast time is present.
code:
-- anonymous cast ballots
CREATE TABLE anonymous_ballot (
    ballot_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    election_id     VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    preference_1    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    preference_2    VARCHAR(40),
    preference_3    VARCHAR(40),
    cast_at         TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    receipt_hash    VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ballot_election_fk FOREIGN KEY (election_id) REFERENCES election(election_id),
    CONSTRAINT ballot_cast_at_not_null CHECK (cast_at IS NOT NULL),
    CONSTRAINT ballot_receipt_unique UNIQUE (receipt_hash)
);

CREATE INDEX ballot_election_idx ON anonymous_ballot (election_id);
hard_negatives:
-- participation record separated from ballot contents
CREATE TABLE participation (
    participation_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    voter_id         VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    election_id      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    voted_at         TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT participation_unique UNIQUE (voter_id, election_id)
);
-- election master table
CREATE TABLE election (
    election_id   VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    title         VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    open_at       TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    close_at      TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    status        VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT election_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('SCHEDULED','OPEN','CLOSED','CERTIFIED','PUBLISHED')),
    CONSTRAINT election_times_order CHECK (close_at > open_at)
);

requirement: The results table shall never be writable by any application account used for voter-facing services; only the tally service may write to it.
The counting job shall produce a precinct-level result summary showing, for each precinct, the number of valid ballots and the vote total per candidate.
